Container.Name: blackcat
Container.Overview:
A personal agent that runs at home. It keeps a searchable copy of your messages (WhatsApp, Telegram, email; read-only), reminds you, watches chats for what you care about, and looks after your machines over SSH, Home Assistant and UniFi. You use it with commands, and optionally through a Telegram bot and in plain words with a model (Claude Code, under your own sign-in). Everything stays on this machine.
After starting it, open a console in the container and run: bc status To connect a Telegram bot: bc tg bot pair To sign in to Claude Code (optional): claude

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Settings, messages, logins and logs. Everything that is yours. Back this folder up (or use blackcat's own: bc backup setup).

Config.Name: Home
Config.Description: The Claude Code sign-in is kept here, so that it survives an update of the container. Only used when you add a model.

Config.Name: Your own plugins
Config.Description: Plugins you write or add yourself (optional).

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Reminders and schedules use local time. For example Europe/Lisbon, America/New_York, Asia/Tokyo.
